description:
Cast the creature that causes you to get energy counter(s) when it enters the battlefield by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When the creature enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get at least {E}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
